pi.title: Indifference Price - PI
pi.description: The Indifference Price determines the minimum average price for the cost of electricity, aiming to enable a possible migration from the Regulated Contracting Environment (ACR) to the Free Contracting Environment (ACL).

aplac.title: Contract Allocation Application - APLAC
aplac.description: Analyzes the user's energy consumption history and returns a report with the best possible contracting scenario in the free market, considering a portfolio of bilateral contracts that can be chosen by the user. Along with this scenario, the tool calculates the minimum price (indifference price), which may enable a possible migration to the free market.

wind_simulator.title: Wind Generation Control Simulator
wind_simulator.description: Web application that recommends generation curtailment values for wind farm clusters based on the power flow limit of the 525 kV Nova Santa Rita/Povo Novo transmission line.

voice_transcription.title: Voice Transcription Logging System for Operations
voice_transcription.description: Web application for logging information from voice transcriptions of power sector operators, built as a minimum viable product that proves the concept that recording information through the operator's voice is advantageous for the operation and post-operation sectors of the power industry.

redsquare.title: RedSquare Game
redsquare.description: Game developed with the Construct 2 engine during the technical course in Digital Game Programming.

timelinelist.title: TimeLineList App
timelinelist.description: App developed during the Mobile Development (Android) course for cataloging movies and TV shows, with ratings, status, and reactions.

legendas_organizer.title: Legendas TV Organizer
legendas_organizer.description: Python utility that automatically selects and organizes the correct subtitle. Just run the utility in a folder containing the video file and the legendas.tv .zip, and the files are organized automatically.

automatic_renamer.title: Automatic Renamer
automatic_renamer.description: Python utility with a graphical interface that renames files or folders following a logic based on the file type (TV show, movie, or anime).

classifier.title: Classification System for Verbal Communication in Power System Operations
classifier.description: Python system for classifying verbal communication in power system operations, using multiple machine learning models capable of solving multiclass classification problems. Input can be text or audio (speech or file transcription).

legendas_viewer.title: Legendas TV Viewer App
legendas_viewer.description: App for browsing the legendas.tv website.

movie_grabber.title: Movie Grabber
movie_grabber.description: Executable for downloading movies from the topdezfilmes website.
